instruction: Can you disable video auto-resize? I don't want the window to change size when videos start playing.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);
